answers.text: Quote: 'A lagging long average does not outvote the tape.' My gate is the Trend Template, all eight (C3). A new high on an unordered stack is a turn, not a confirmed stage 2 (C2). Not conceded.

Quote: 'Averages are not tangled on my read.' Fair on the short averages: W ema9 89.2131 over ema21 87.8866. My test is the long stack: ma_50 88.21 under ma_100 88.6 leaves criterion 4 unproven, and rs_rank_pct 63.57 fails criterion 8 (C3, C11). A normal reaction in a non-leader is still a non-leader. Not conceded.

Quote: 'Not tangled on my frames ... RS unread.' The refuter leaves RS unread; my gate reads it: rs_rank_pct 63.57 is under the 70 floor (C3 criterion 8, C11), and ma_50 88.21 under ma_100 88.6 keeps criterion 4 unproven. H1 ema9 93.1987 vs ema21 93.0587 is flat. Not conceded.
